subject: HealthSage pilot: request for strict-serving mode and region-only routing
messages:
From: elaine@healthsage.io
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 17:15:00 +00:00
Subject: Pilot ask — strict-serving mode for HealthSage evaluation

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. As we prepare the clinical pilot, our security and compliance team needs the evaluation to run with strict serving constraints: specifically

- Region lock to EU (data residency) — no routing to non-EU regions
- Force the q4x-16b-eu model variant we validated (we cannot accept automatic model substitution)
- Disable cross-region fallback and hosted-model fallback for the duration of the pilot (6 weeks)

I understand this is an operational exception but it's a gating requirement for our IRB and clinical reviewers. Can Redwood operationally enforce the above for a named pilot (HealthSage POC) and provide a short runbook we can hand to our auditors?

Attaching the pilot requirements summary (see inline). Please advise timeline; we hoped to start staging next Monday.

Best,
Elaine Reynolds
Director, Product Ops
HealthSage

Attachments: HealthSage_pilot_requirements.pdf
From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: elaine@healthsage.io
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 19:02:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — strict-serving mode for HealthSage evaluation

Elaine — thanks for the clear summary and the urgency. We're keen to support the pilot. A few clarifying Qs before ops can lock anything down:

1) Is the q4x-16b-eu variant the exact model artifact you want us to pin (model: q4x-16b-eu, version: v1.3.2)?
2) For the no-fallback requirement: do you also want to prevent fallback to a quantized fallback in the same region (i.e., any automatic substitution), or is a same-region compatible fallback acceptable in case of capacity failures?
3) Who is the legal contact for the MOU and SLAs (CC Paul if you want us to coordinate contract-side)?

From a timeline perspective: if we get confirmation by EOD Tue we can provision a dedicated routing rule + staged runbook by Thu, and a short ops run (non-prod) next Mon. Marcus / Karthik — can you flag major constraints here? Grace / Irene — can you help with the auditor runbook and the compliance checklist?

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Sr. Product Manager, Routing & Controls
Redwood Inference

Mina / team — quick ops take and suggested compromise:

- We can pin the exact artifact q4x-16b-eu:v1.3.2 to HealthSage's routing policy for the pilot, and enforce EU-region-only serving.
- Full disable of any fallback is risky for availability: if an instance becomes unhealthy the request path would fail. Our standard hard-fallback prevents user-facing errors.

Compromise proposal (safe hard lock):
1) Enforce region-only routing and model pin (hard) for all prod and staging tokens tied to the pilot.
2) Allow a same-region compatibility fallback but only to a pre-approved list (e.g., q4x-16b-eu-v1.2.x) — no cross-region fallback and no hosted-shared-model fallback.
3) Implement strict throttling and capacity reservations for the pilot window so fallback likelihood is minimized.

I attached an ops runbook snippet that shows failure modes and mitigation steps (ops-runbook-strict-serving.pdf). If HealthSage insists on absolute no-fallback we need a maintenance SLA (on-call window, manual failover) to accept the risk.

Karthik — can you confirm whether routing rule changes require infra lead time beyond provisioning (IIRC we need ~48 hours for capacity reservation in EU zones)?

Marcus Lin
Director, Infrastructure Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ops-runbook-strict-serving.pdf

We can accept the same-region compatibility fallback limited to the pre-approved list you suggested, provided:
- That list is documented in the runbook and cannot be expanded without written approval from our security lead (security@healthsage.io).
- You create a short audit artifact that shows routing enforcement and the model pin for our auditors.
- Timeline to staging remains next Monday.

Paul (cc'd) — please pick up the MOU/SLAs with Mina and Irene. I'll attach our draft MOU for reference.

Appreciate the collaboration — Elaine
